{"verdict":"fail","reason":"The unsubscribe function returned by on/once is not tied to its own registration: it searches by function and once-flag, so when the same listener is registered multiple times, calling an unsubscribe twice (or out of order) can remove a different registration, violating the requirement that it remove exactly that registration and do nothing on repeat calls."}
